sources.title: Udyam Registration : Zero cost, No Fee and Free Registration of MSMEs. This is official website of Govt. of India, Ministry of MSME. No other website/portal/app is official. MSMEs are requested to do MSME Registration here only
UDYAM REGISTRATION FORM - For New Enterprise who are not Registered yet as MSME
SCHEMES FOR STARTERS | MSME CHAMPIONS | Our Small Hands to make you LARGE
MSME CHAMPIONS | Our Small Hands to make you LARGE
Commissioner of Cottage and Rural Industries
Commissioner of Cottage and Rural Industries

facts.claim: Udyam Registration is free of cost and paperless.
facts.subject: udyam_registration
facts.evidence: Udyam Registration : Zero cost, No Fee and Free Registration of MSMEs.

facts.claim: Udyam Registration is the only official website for MSME registration by the Government of India.
facts.subject: udyam_registration
facts.evidence: This is official website of Govt. of India, Ministry of MSME. No other website/portal/app is official. MSMEs are requested to do MSME Registration here only

facts.claim: MSME registration process is fully online and paperless.
facts.subject: msme_registration
facts.evidence: MSME registration process is fully online, paperless and based on self-declaration.

facts.claim: No documents or proof are required to be uploaded for registering an MSME.
facts.subject: msme_registration
facts.evidence: No documents or proof are required to be uploaded for registering an MSME.

facts.claim: Only an Aadhaar Number is enough for registration.
facts.subject: msme_registration
facts.evidence: Only Adhaar Number will be enough for registration.

facts.claim: PAN and GSTIN are required for Udyam Registration as per the CGST Act 2017 and as notified by the Ministry of MSME.
facts.subject: udyam_registration
facts.evidence: Having PAN and GSTIN (As per applicablity of CGST Act 2017 and as notified by the ministry of MSME vide S.O. 1055(E) dated 05th March 2021 ) is required for Udyam Registration with effect from 01.04.2021.

facts.claim: Those who have EM-II or UAM registration or any other registration issued by any authority under the Ministry of MSME will have to re-register themselves.
facts.subject: msme_registration
facts.evidence: Those who have EM-II or UAM registration or any other registration issued by any authority under the Ministry of MSME, will have to re-register themselves.

facts.claim: No enterprise shall file more than one Udyam Registration.
facts.subject: udyam_registration
facts.evidence: No enterprise shall file more than one Udyam Registration.

facts.claim: A permanent registration number will be given after registration.
facts.subject: udyam_registration
facts.evidence: A permanent registration number will be given after registration.

facts.claim: After completion of the registration process, a certificate will be issued online.
facts.subject: udyam_registration
facts.evidence: After completion of the process of registration, a certificate will be issued online.

facts.claim: The certificate will have a dynamic QR Code from which the web page on the portal and details about the enterprise can be accessed.
facts.subject: udyam_certificate
facts.evidence: This certificate will have a dynamic QR Code from which the web page on our Portal and details about the enterprise can be accessed.

facts.claim: There will be no need for renewal of Registration.
facts.subject: udyam_registration
facts.evidence: There will be no need for renewal of Registration.

facts.claim: The single window systems at Champions Control Rooms and at DICs will help in the process.
facts.subject: udyam_registration
facts.evidence: Our single window systems at Champions Control Rooms and at DICs will help you in the process.

facts.claim: The online system will be fully integrated with Income Tax and GSTIN systems.
facts.subject: udyam_registration
facts.evidence: Our online system will be fully integrated with Income Tax and GSTIN systems.

facts.claim: For grievances, call or WhatsApp on +91 8308809334 from Monday to Friday between 10:00 AM and 06:00 PM.
facts.subject: udyam_registration
facts.evidence: Call or Whatsapp on +91 8308809334 Mon to Fri : 10:00 AM - 06:00 PM

facts.claim: Aadhaar number is required for Udyam Registration.
facts.subject: udyam_registration
facts.evidence: ✔ Aadhaar number shall be required for Udyam Registration.

facts.claim: The Aadhaar number must be of the proprietor for a proprietorship firm.
facts.subject: udyam_registration
facts.evidence: ✔ The Aadhaar number shall be of the proprietor in the case of a proprietorship firm, of the managing partner in the case of a partnership firm and of a karta in the case of a Hindu Undivided Family (HUF).

facts.claim: For a Company or a Limited Liability Partnership, GSTIN and PAN along with Aadhaar number are required.
facts.subject: udyam_registration
facts.evidence: ✔ In case of a Company or a Limited Liability Partnership or a Cooperative Society or a Society or a Trust, the organisation or its authorised signatory shall provide its GSTIN(As per applicablity of CGST Act 2017 and as notified by the ministry of MSME vide S.O. 1055(E) dated 05th March 2021 ) and PAN along with its Aadhaar number.

facts.claim: Aadhaar data will not be stored or shared by the Ministry of MSME.
facts.subject: udyam_registration
facts.evidence: Ministry of MSME, Government of India, have informed me that my aadhaar data will not be stored/shared.

facts.claim: For grievances, call or Whatsapp on +91 8308809334.
facts.subject: udyam_registration
facts.evidence: For Grievances Call or Whatsapp on +91 8308809334

facts.claim: Office of DCMSME, Ministry of MSME, Kartavya Bhawan 3 - New Delhi is the address.
facts.subject: udyam_registration

detail.address: Office of DCMSME, Ministry of MSME, Kartavya Bhawan 3 - New Delhi

facts.evidence: Address Office of DCMSME, Ministry of MSME, Kartavya Bhawan 3 - New Delhi

facts.claim: The applicant must be at least 18 years old to be eligible for the PMEGP scheme.
facts.subject: pmegp_eligibility
facts.evidence: Target Beneficiary: Unemployed rural and urban youth; Eligibility Criteria: Any individual above 18 years of age, SHGs, Charitable trusts, Registered Societies etc.

facts.claim: The PMEGP scheme allows a maximum project cost of Rs. 25 lakh for manufacturing units.
facts.subject: pmegp_project_cost
facts.evidence: Allowed Project Cost: for Manufacturing Unit: Rs. 25 lakh; Service Sector Unit: Rs. 10 lakh, Trading SectorUnit Rs. 10 lakh in North Eastern Region, LWE-affected districts and Andaman & Nicobar Islands

facts.claim: The PMEGP scheme provides a subsidy of 15% of the project cost in urban areas for the general category.
facts.subject: pmegp_subsidy
facts.evidence: Subsidy: General Category: 15% of the project cost in urban areas, 25% in rural areas;

facts.claim: The PMEGP scheme requires the applicant to contribute 10% of the project cost for the general category.
facts.subject: pmegp_contribution
facts.evidence: Contribution of the Entrepreneur: General: 10 %, Special category: 5 %.

facts.claim: The PMEGP scheme requires the applicant to apply online through the website https://www.kviconline.gov.in/pmegpeportal.
facts.subject: pmegp_application
facts.evidence: The applicant should apply in the following Website- https://www.kviconline.gov.in/pmegpeportal The applicant to follow the guidelines of this portal.

facts.claim: The PMEGP scheme requires the applicant to complete an Entrepreneurship Development Programme (EDP) training.
facts.subject: pmegp_edp
facts.evidence: Implementing Agency will arrange for the Entrepreneurship Development Programme (EDP) Training for the applicant, which is available on line as well;

facts.claim: The PMEGP scheme requires the applicant to submit the EDP certificate along with their contribution to the bank to receive the first instalment of the loan.
facts.subject: pmegp_edp_certificate
facts.evidence: On EDP completion, a certificate is issued to the applicant and same is to be submitted along with applicant contribution to the concerned Bank to get first instalment of the loan.

facts.claim: The Gram Udyog Vikas Yojna targets artisans, unemployed youth, and self-help groups (SHGs).
facts.subject: gram_udyog_vikas_yojna
facts.evidence: Eligibility & Conditions: Target beneficiary: Artisans, Unemployed Youth and Self Help Groups (SHGs)

facts.claim: The Credit Guarantee on Loans to Micro and Small Enterprises and New Entrepreneurs provides guarantee coverage of 85% for micro enterprises up to Rs. 5 lakh.
facts.subject: credit_guarantee_scheme
facts.evidence: Guarantee coverage ranges from 85% (Micro Enterprise up to Rs 5 lakh) to 75% (others);

facts.claim: The Entrepreneurship and Skill Development Programme (ESDP) requires at least 40% women participation.
facts.subject: esdp_women_participation
facts.evidence: As per scheme guidelines, in EAP and E-SDP there should be overall 40% women participation.

facts.claim: The Prime Minister’s Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP) provides a margin money subsidy on bank loans for setting up new micro-enterprises.
facts.subject: pmegp_scheme
facts.evidence: Bank financed subsidy program for setting up new micro-enterprises in non-farm sector. Margin Money subsidy on Bank Loan ranges from 15% to 35% for projects up to Rs. 25 lakhs in manufacturing and Rs. 10 lakhs in service sector

facts.claim: The PMEGP scheme provides a higher margin money subsidy for beneficiaries from special categories such as SC/ST/Women/PH/Minorities/Ex-Servicemen/NER.
facts.subject: pmegp_scheme
facts.evidence: For beneficiaries belonging to special categories such as SC/ST/Women/PH/Minorities/Ex-Servicemen/NER, the margin money subsidy is 35% in rural areas and 25% in urban areas.

facts.claim: The PMEGP scheme is applicable for individuals above 18 years of age, SHGs, Charitable trusts, and Registered Societies.
facts.subject: pmegp_scheme
facts.evidence: Scheme applicable for Any individual above 18 years of age, SHGs, Charitable trusts, Registered Societies etc.

facts.claim: The PMEGP scheme requires a 10% own contribution of the project cost for general category beneficiaries.
facts.subject: pmegp_scheme
facts.evidence: The own contribution of the beneficiary is 10% of the project cost in case of general category

facts.claim: The PMEGP scheme requires a 5% own contribution of the project cost for reserved category beneficiaries.
facts.subject: pmegp_scheme
facts.evidence: and 5% of the project cost in case of reserved category (SC/ST/OBC/PH/Women/Ex Servicemen/ NER) beneficiaries.

facts.claim: The PMEGP scheme allows banks to sanction and release 90 to 95 percent of the total project cost after loan approval.
facts.subject: pmegp_scheme
facts.evidence: If the application for loan is approved, Banks sanction and release the balance amount of 90 to 95 percent of the total project cost suitably for setting up of the units by the beneficiaries.

facts.claim: The PMEGP scheme provides support services like awareness camps, workshops, and EDP training for sustainability of the projects.
facts.subject: pmegp_scheme
facts.evidence: In order to have sustainability of the projects/units set up under the scheme, support services are also provided in the form of Backward & Forward Linkages by organizing events like awareness camps, workshops, EDP training to the beneficiaries, exhibitions, etc.

facts.claim: The PMEGP scheme has an online process flow for application and disbursement of margin money directly to financing branches.
facts.subject: pmegp_scheme
facts.evidence: Government of India has introduced online process flow of application and disbursement of Margin Money directly to financing branches.

facts.claim: Corporation Bank is engaged as a single National Level Agency for operating the online fund flow system of PMEGP.
facts.subject: pmegp_scheme
facts.evidence: Corporation Bank was engaged as a single National Level Agency for operating the online fund flow system of PMEGP.

facts.claim: A one-page online application form is mandatory for individuals and institutional beneficiaries on the PMEGP e-portal.
facts.subject: pmegp_scheme
facts.evidence: One-page online application form is mandatory for individuals and institutional beneficiaries on the e-portal.

facts.claim: SMS/e-mail alerts are sent to applicants automatically by the system or by the concerned officials at each stage of the PMEGP process.
facts.subject: pmegp_scheme
facts.evidence: SMS/e-mail alerts sent to the applicant automatically by the system or by the concerned officials at the process of each stage.

facts.claim: Model Projects of different KVI activities are available on the PMEGP e-portal for the benefit of potential beneficiaries.
facts.subject: pmegp_scheme
facts.evidence: Model Projects of different KVI activities have been put up on PMEGP e-portal for the benefit of potential beneficiaries.

facts.claim: Model Village Industries projects prepared by NSIC are linked to the PMEGP website.
facts.subject: pmegp_scheme
facts.evidence: Model Village Industries projects prepared by NSIC have also been linked to the website.

facts.claim: The Government encourages PMEGP units to adopt the Udyog Aadhar Memorandum (UAM) to register online.
facts.subject: pmegp_scheme
facts.evidence: To increase the registration of MSMEs in the country, the Government has undertaken measures that the PMEGP units can adopt the Udyog Aadhar Memorandum (UAM) to register online.

facts.subject: pan_number

facts.claim: A password must be at least 8 characters long and include uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and special characters.
facts.subject: password
facts.evidence: પાસવર્ડ * પાસવર્ડ લખો પાસવર્ડ ઓછામાં ઓછો ૮ અક્ષરોનો હોવો જોઈએ અને તેમાં મોટા-નાના અક્ષરો, અંક તથા વિશેષ અક્ષર હોવા જોઈએ,પાસવર્ડમાં અક્ષરો માન્ય નથી.

facts.claim: The password must be confirmed by re-entering it.
